market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil spike and 5%+ 10-year create headwinds. AI slowdown narrative pressures tech. Consumer stress accelerates. Expect 3-5% equity volatility. BofA/Tallbacken bullish calls may prove premature if Fed hikes materialize.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI revenue confirmation (Adobe, Snowflake) supports tech recovery post-correction. China reintegration and tariff normalization offer 12-month upside. Energy transition and defense spending provide structural tailwinds. Consumer recovery delayed by 2-3 quarters.
